issue_reference: Assigned in the registration pull request rather than guessed in advance, after the Task 3 pilots pre-guessed numbers GitHub then allocated elsewhere.
hypothesis: Every Task 3 comparison froze the inherited network and trained only the 832 opponent-input columns, and the shrinkage dose-response showed those columns accumulate undirected drift against a passive opponent. Against three rule_based_agents the opponent inputs finally carry information the agent needs to survive, and the inherited weights are the ones that must change to use it. The comparison tests whether lifting the freeze converts strong-opponent experience into a better tournament agent, at the registered risk of losing the Task 1 and Task 2 behaviour the frozen regime preserved exactly.

prior_evidence.task3_closeout: Four registered Task 3 comparisons failed their screens against a passive opponent; the shrinkage dose-response converged monotonically on the untrained incumbent, the registered signature of drift rather than signal in the opponent columns. That finding is specific to peaceful_agent, which never threatens the agent.
prior_evidence.exposure: Under the incumbent an opponent is within eight tiles on 1.5% of steps against peaceful_agent. Three rule_based_agents bomb, contest crates and kill, so opponent proximity becomes both frequent and consequential.
prior_evidence.incumbent: The installed Task 3 incumbent scores 4.16 with 0.215 eliminations per game and a 78.5% strict win rate against one peaceful_agent over 320 worlds. It has never been measured against rule_based_agent; this pair establishes that baseline through its no-training reference arm.

intervention.baseline_shared_by_every_arm: the installed Task 3 incumbent as the starting point, native rewards with no approach shaping, one optimizer update per eligible transition, the #168 episode-mixture exploration schedule and learning rate 0.0005
intervention.persistence: training-only; evaluation loads the unchanged archived agent
intervention.registered_risk: Arms with the all_weights scope may lose Task 1 and Task 2 behaviour that the frozen scope preserved exactly. The opponent-free retention suites are gated for exactly that reason and a loss there is a failure, not a trade-off to be argued away afterwards.

random_episode_schedule: All arms: for each five-episode block random.Random(agent_seed + 168000000 + block_index).randrange(5) selects one fully random episode; four greedy episodes.
primary_endpoint: Mean native score per game on classic-rule-based against the unchanged incumbent. Tournament placing is decided by score, so score rather than eliminations is the endpoint this campaign is built to move.

uncertainty.method: hierarchical paired bootstrap over replicas and shared worlds
uncertainty.family: one test family per treatment arm that can be promoted; the promotion rule is conjunctive, so only the arm count is Bonferroni-adjusted
uncertainty.role: registered decision input, not a post-hoc description

selection: An arm is promotable only if every integrity gate, every retention gate and every efficacy gate passes. Among promotable arms the largest mean score gain over the unchanged incumbent is chosen, and within it the median-final replica by that score. The best-looking replica is not selectable. If no arm is promotable the installed incumbent remains the submission candidate.
scientific_gates: Original cumulative Task 1/2/3 requirements are unchanged; this exploratory comparison cannot retrospectively establish any of them.
known_gate_defect: The zero-invalid-action gate counts the unchanged reference's own invalid actions, so no arm could pass it in the Task 3 programme. It is retained unchanged and is expected to fail; read it alongside the per-artifact counts rather than as a discriminator between arms.

machine_allocation.training: 5 concurrent workers, one torch thread each
machine_allocation.latency: one worker on an otherwise idle machine; the only latency source

authorization: Owner 1BlauNitrox requested the first two Task 4 comparisons on 15 September 2026, one per host, and authorized starting the PC one unattended. One registered comparison per host, no automatic extension, no automatic promotion; the README and interpretation follow completed results.
